sloka: ततो रक्तजलम् भीमम् लोहितम् नाम सागरम् ।गत्वा प्रेक्ष्यथ ताम् चैव बृहतीम् कूटशाल्मलीम् ॥४-४०-३९॥
transliteration: tato raktajalam bhīmam lohitam nāma sāgaram ।gatvā prekṣyatha tām caiva bṛhatīm kūṭaśālmalīm ॥4-40-39॥

translations.english: 'You would see there a house of Garuda constructed by Visvakarma. It looks like the Kailasa mountain and is adorned with different kinds of gems.
